name: Yandere Onee-chan no Otouto Shiiku Nikki
original_name: ヤンデレお姉ちゃんの弟飼育日記
source:
The main character lives with his two sisters, Isora and Sakuya. He has recently finished high school, and is preparing to go to college. To do this, he’s planning to move out and go into the city. However, his sisters don’t want him to, and they say that there’s a college right nearby that he can go to. However, he insists, saying that he needs to grow as a person, and to do that he needs to get out of his comfort zone and try new things.

However, his sisters really, REALLY don’t want him to leave. So they do something incredibly ridiculous, yet also incredibly effective:
They divide his room in two with iron bars and a jail cell door. They do this while he is asleep. 

Now, he’s locked in his bedroom, and he can’t get out. He literally can’t get out, the windows are barred, the room is barred, everything is barred. It’s a miniature jail and he’s on the inside of it. Isora visits him and informs him of something: They’re both in love with him. Not the brother-sister kind of love. REAL love. They were going to confess to him, but he decided to move away, and they just can’t have that, can they? So they built him a cage and locked him in it. They’re going to take care of him for the rest of his life, and they can all have "fun" together. Thus, the translated title of the game: "Yandere Big Sister’s Brother-Raising Diary".

[Edited from Dark Eye Translations]
translation:
主角和两个姐姐伊空与咲夜一起生活。他最近刚刚高中毕业，正在准备上大学。为此，他计划搬到城里独自生活。

然而，姐姐们不想让他离开，并说附近就有一所大学，他完全可以去那里上学。可他坚持认为，自己需要成长；为了成长，就必须离开舒适区，尝试新的事物。

但姐姐们真的、真的不想让他走。于是，她们采取了一个荒唐却极其有效的办法：

趁他睡着时，用铁栅栏和监狱门把他的房间一分为二。

现在，他被锁在自己的卧室里，无法出去。窗户上有栅栏，房间被栅栏围住，一切都被封死了。这是一座微型监狱，而他就在里面。

伊空来看望他，并告诉他一件事：她们都爱着他。不是兄弟姐妹之间的爱，而是真正的爱情。

她们本想向他告白，可他却决定搬走，她们怎么可能接受？所以，她们造了一个笼子，把他锁在里面。她们要照顾他一辈子，大家一起“享受”生活。

这就是游戏译名《病娇姐姐的弟弟饲养日记》的由来。

[改编自 Dark Eye Translations]
